resources.string: Mari Domingi
Mari Domingi is listening · %1$s
Hello, little ones! I\'m Mari Domingi.
Dozing by the fire… tap the microphone to wake me up.
So quiet and calm. I can hear the moon rising.
Peace and quiet, like the farmhouse on a snowy night.
How lovely! This calls for a roasted apple.
Nice! Everyone is chatting softly.
Just the right amount of noise, like sheep humming on the hill.
Good talking, good listening. My apples are smiling.
Hmm… it\'s getting a bit loud in here.
The sheep would be startled! Can we turn it down a little?
Could we play more quietly? Even Olentzero would hear us from the mountain.
Oh dear… can we use our indoor voices?
That\'s a lot of noise. My old ears are tired.
Please help me find some quiet, little ones.
So loud! My apples are rolling away!
Goodness! Hands over my ears! Can we be quiet?
Big noise! Let\'s take a quiet break, like on Christmas Eve.
Mari Domingi is asleep, her tall headdress nodding under a crescent moon
Mari Domingi is happy and holds up an apple
Mari Domingi is fine and smiles, holding her basket
Mari Domingi is worried and puts a hand to her cheek
Mari Domingi is sad, with a tear and her head lowered
Mari Domingi covers her ears with her hands, her basket dropped and apples rolling away
Hehe! That tickles, dear.
Gentle pats are my favourite.
Want an apple? Take the reddest one.
Shh, let\'s be quiet together and look at the stars.
Soft pats, soft voices.
